subject: Action required: your account has been limited
body:
Dear customer,

We detected unusual activity on your PayPal account. Your account has been temporarily limited. To restore full access you must verify your identity within 24 hours or your funds will be frozen.

Verify now: https://paypa1-secure-verify.com/login

If you need help call our support line: +1 (888) 555-0142.

PayPal Security Team
